text: All the Kanaka boys are dead now; one fell overboard of the launch, and one died of a wounded heel that he poisoned in some way with plant-juice. Three went away in the yacht, and I suppose and hope were drowned. The other one—was killed. Well, I have replaced them. Montgomery went on much as you are disposed to do at first, and then—” “What became of the other one?” said I, sharply,—“the other Kanaka who was killed?” “The fact is, after I had made a number of human creatures I made a Thing—” He hesitated.
